W3C Standard Gamepad mapping (canonical-recall, corroborated by w3c.github.io/gamepad + adamjones.me): buttons 0=A 1=B 2=X 3=Y 4=L1 5=R1 6=L2(analog) 7=R2(analog) 8=Back/View 9=Start/Menu 10=L3 11=R3 12=DUp 13=DDown 14=DLeft 15=DRight 16=Guide(optional); axes 0=LX 1=LY 2=RX 3=RY, buttons [0..1], axes [-1..1], gamepad.mapping==='standard'.

GameSir X2s Type-C (community-data): telescopic USB-C wired, 16-input twin-stick asymmetric layout, Hall-effect sticks AND Hall-effect analog triggers (256-level), microswitch shoulders, hair-trigger mode via Capture+LT/RT held 2s. Type-C model is wired (low latency). Defaults on Android to a DualSense-like HID mode with a switchable user-mapping mode. Sources: slashgear.com/1546147, gamesir.com/products/gamesir-x2s, laptopmag review, techradar review, manuals.plus x2s manual.

CONSEQUENCE: because the X2s can enumerate as DualSense-like HID, mapping!=='standard' is a REAL failure mode -> RI-JRN04 must specify a fallback remap path keyed on gamepad.id, not assume standard mapping.

Chrome/Android, Samsung Internet and Firefox Android all expose the Gamepad API; controllers commonly do not appear in navigator.getGamepads() until a button is pressed (user-gesture gating) -> a 'no controller detected' screen that appears before first press is a defect.
Direct WebFetch of w3c.github.io, gamesir.com, manuals.plus all returned 403 as the brief predicted; all X2s facts are from WebSearch result summaries, labelled community-data.

RULING (RI-JRN05 §A): IndexedDB = sole authoritative store; localStorage BANNED for save data (allowed only as a <=1KB pointer record); file export/import MANDATORY as the eviction-proof second path; no server. Write protocol = single readwrite IDB txn over blobs+saves+meta with monotonic generation + sha256 digest + A/B double-buffered slots.

BUTTON MAP DECIDED (RI-JRN04 §C): souls-default = 5:light 7:heavy(analog,charge>=0.85) 4:block(hold) 6:parry(analog) 1:roll(tap<12f)/sprint(hold>=12f) 0:interact 2:use_item 3:two_hand(hold) 10:jump 11:lock_on 14:swap_left 15:swap_right 9:menu; 12/13/8 reserved; 16 always unbound. souls-handheld profile moves jump->0, interact->3 tap / two_hand->3 hold, keeps 10 as secondary interact. Deadzones: L radial 0.14 in / 0.92 out linear; R 0.10 in, curve m^2.0; triggers T_fire 0.35 T_release 0.20 T_full 0.85 with hysteresis; read .value never .pressed.

RI-PLT01 ruling: Tier-S (software-valid, scoreable in this container) = draw calls, triangles, programs, materials, state changes, texture/geometry MB, skinned meshes, shadow lights, bytes-allocated-per-sim-step, GC counts+attribution, sim CPU time in calibrated sim_units (render disabled, +/-25% error bar), sim/render decoupling, frame-rate independence, trace determinism. Tier-H (needs real GPU + attested manifest) = fps, p50/p99/p99.9 frame time, worst-frame-in-combat<=33ms, >100ms frames, GC pause DURATION, overdraw/fill, GPU memory, shader compile stalls, compositor, thermals, input-to-photon. Tier-S weight 64 / Tier-H 36; unmeasurable Tier-H stays in denominator (rule T2) so a container-only run caps at 64 -> ladder 5.
